steps.en: OCMS receives the PLUS permanent suspension request for the notices
steps.id: OCMS menerima permintaan permanent suspension dari PLUS untuk notice

steps.en: OCMS validates that the permanent suspension request can be allowed
steps.id: OCMS memvalidasi bahwa permintaan permanent suspension boleh diizinkan
steps.why_en: Pre-check for already suspended notices skips the stage and court rule, so it can say allowed when the real run rejects.
steps.why_id: Pre-check untuk notice yang sudah suspended melewati aturan stage dan court, jadi bisa bilang boleh padahal proses sebenarnya menolak.

steps.en: OCMS checks whether the notice already has a permanent suspension
steps.id: OCMS memeriksa apakah notice sudah punya permanent suspension

steps.en: OCMS tells PLUS that a permanent suspension already exists
steps.id: OCMS memberi tahu PLUS bahwa sudah ada permanent suspension
steps.why_en: OCMS answers allowed and replaces the old suspension; it never tells PLUS about the existing one.
steps.why_id: OCMS menjawab boleh dan mengganti suspension lama; PLUS tidak pernah diberi tahu soal yang sudah ada.
